name: smwmusic-super-mario-kart-rainbow-road
title: Super Mario Kart - Rainbow Road
description:
I really should have put some mode 7 trivia in the F-Zero port but I guess that chance has passed lol

The original Rainbow Road music from Super Mario Kart, released in mid 1992 for Japan and America and early 1993 for Europe.

It was a time when drifting physics were very different and every track was flat. Also speaking of which, if you don't know how to drift in Mario Kart then you need to figure that out asap. Please... people, drifting is important.

Did you know that there's an editor for this game too? It's called Epic Edit and I think it's actually still being maintained to this day... just checked. Last change was about a year ago. Also its open source.



This port is a little more laid-back than the real thing. It's not comatose, but it's not exactly hyper-exciting. If you want something as truly upbeat as the original, there's a nice sampled version of it somewhere on the site.

As usual, accuracy is never a priority with stuff from me.
